name: expand-motion
description: Expand a terse motion / composition brief into a full prompt: grounded in five images and three moving references, written as numbered beats.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a one-line motion brief into a full prompt
interface.longDescription: Get past the blank page on a motion piece. Give it a one-liner and it finds a look (five images from one aesthetic on are.na), three moving references worth copying, and real assets, then writes a numbered, beat-by-beat prompt with every reference attached. Good for when you don't know what you want yet, and for exploring directions you wouldn't have thought of.
defaultPrompt: Expand this prompt: 5 second clip for a payments api, a request leaves the code and comes back as a payment confirmed
Expand this prompt: quick 5 second twitter post, our design tool just hit 10,000 users
